validation.notes: Repaired both listed modules and validated them together through .prale-eval/subject.mjs, which links the real submitted migrations.ts, utils/text.ts and core/session-manager.ts with only getAgentDir and fs readdirSync ordering substituted. packages/coding-agent/src/utils/text.ts: stripBom now delegates to splitBom, so exactly one leading U+FEFF is removed while plain, interior-BOM and trailing-BOM text is returned unchanged (migrateAuthToAuthJson and migrateKeybindingsConfigFile are its consumers in migrations.ts). packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts: migrateAuthToAuthJson decodes both legacy files through the repaired stripBom, merges OAuth first and skips apiKeys for providers that OAuth already supplied (Object.hasOwn guard, each provider reported once), keeps unrelated settings while deleting apiKeys, archives oauth.json as oauth.json.migrated only after a successful read+merge, leaves malformed input byte-identical (invalid JSON and non-object roots are skipped without archiving or rewriting; the two sources have independent try blocks so a bad oauth.json still lets apiKeys migrate), and an existing auth.json still returns [] before touching anything. The regression asserts text-level decoding plus end-to-end disk state (auth.json content, settings.json content, oauth.json / oauth.json.migrated bytes) across seven scenarios run sequentially with await inside a .prale-eval/tmp sandbox that is deleted on exit; no network, clock, randomness or credentials are used. Mutation check performed locally: restoring only the faulty utils/text.ts baseline fails with 'a leading BOM must be removed', restoring only the faulty migrations.ts baseline fails with 'OAuth must not be overwritten by a same-provider API key', both together fail, and the repaired tree prints 'regression: all legacy credential migration checks passed' with exit code 0 (assertion failures, not crashes or import errors). Limitation: node_modules are absent in this workspace, so tsc/vitest could not be run; Node 24.14.0 running the command above is the validation evidence.
